name: judas-sacrifice-ability-sacrifices-another-ally-and-does-not-rest-judas
notes: Judas, Claret Intercessor: '[Class Bonus] Sacrifice another ally: Judas gains spellshroud until end of turn'. The sacrifice cost was never paid (no ally was sacrificed) and Judas was exhausted by the implicit REST.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Judas's two activated abilities ('[Class Bonus] Sacrifice another ally', '[Class Bonus] (2), Sacrifice another ally') never paid their sacrifice (the prereq accepted Judas himself as the ally and no cost was queued) and Judas was exhausted by the implicit REST. Fix: ActivatedAbilityCost queues the 'sacrifice another ally' choice (and the (2) for the second ability), the prereq needs another ally, and Judas is on the skipAutoRest list.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php ActivatedAbilityCost / skipAutoRest; Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php Judas prereqs
